paper_title: Constraining Rapidly Oscillating Scalar Dark Matter Using Dynamic Decoupling
coupling_convention: g_eγ and g_αe (dimensionless/non-standard scalar DM couplings)
notes: This paper measures bounds on non-standard scalar dark matter couplings via dynamic decoupling in atomic transitions (arXiv:1902.02788). The bounds (Figure 2, 95% CL) are on g_αe (coupling to electron mass variations) and g_eγ (coupling to fine-structure constant variations), which do not map to AxionLimitBench canonical coupling types. The couplings are presented in a scalar-field-to-fundamental-constants framework rather than the standard axion formalism. Mass range: 1e-14 to 1e-8 eV. DM density: 0.3e-6 eV/cm³ (local Galactic density). See Figure 2(a) for g_αe bounds, Figure 2(b) for g_eγ bounds, with comparison to equivalence-principle and fifth-force constraints. Cannot extract data_points due to non-standard coupling parametrization outside AxionLimitBench scope.
